title: OptMem
brief: Permanent memory for AI agents by Victor Taelin: the whole integration is a 426-token prompt plus a single dependency-free Python script installed with one curl command. You paste a `## Memory` block into your agent's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, then use `memo wake` (read memory at session start) and `memo note` (record one-liners), plus `nap`, `recall`, `zoom`, and `forget`; storage is an append-only log with a rebuildable binary-tree summary cache (1M memories ≈ 608 MB, wake in 0.03s).
details: OptMem (github.com/VictorTaelin/OptMem) gives AI agents permanent memory via a 426-token prompt plus a single dependency-free Python script called memo. The agent runs memo wake at the start of every session, memo note to record one-line memories, memo nap to answer pending merges, memo recall for word-for-word regex search over everything ever recorded, and memo zoom or forget to navigate or drop nodes of a binary summary tree. Storage is an append-only LOG.txt with a rebuildable TREE summary cache under ~/.optmem, using fixed-width records so every lookup is a single seek (a million memories wake in 0.03s). Install with one curl command, then paste the printed Memory block at the top of the agent's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
